TARGET DOCUMENT PROFILE (rules/documents.yaml, hot-loaded — the identification reference):

- id: broker_invoice — Broker Tax Invoice
  description: the freight forwarder/broker firm's OWN tax invoice for the shipment's logistics services (brokerage/agency, freight handling, warehousing, demurrage — the firm's own charges), NOT supplier bills, packing lists, bills of entry, commercial invoices, third-party terminal/port bills, or other supporting documents
  allow_no_match: False (below selector min_score 0.5 -> flag_no_document_match, never guess)
  identification keywords (user-defined HINTS — a target document of this kind typically contains at least one; a document that matches the description but NO keyword is STILL the target — keywords never disqualify): ['BROKERAGE', 'AGENCY CHARGES', 'FREIGHT & FORWARDING']
  extraction schema: profile

The images below are the pages of one PDF attachment, in order. Extract per the instructions and output ONLY a single JSON object matching this schema:

{
  "selected_document": {
    "name": string|null,
    "document_pages": [int],
    "reason": string,
    "confidence": number
  },
  "header_fields": [
    {{
      "name": "invoice_number" | "invoice_date" | "boe_number" | "boe_date" | "hawb_number" | "total_invoice_amount" | "pan",
      "value": string|object|null,
      "confidence": number,
      "source": "page N (render image)" | null,
      "source_region": {{ "page": int, "bbox": [x0, y0, x1, y1] }} | null
    }}
  ],
  "line_items": [
    {{ "description": string, "hsn_sac": string|null, "taxable": string|null, "tax": string|null, "total": string|null, "confidence": number, "source": "page N (render image)", "source_region": {{ "page": int, "bbox": [x0, y0, x1, y1] }} | null }}
  ],

  "notes": [string],
  "status": "extracted" | "flag_no_document_match" | "flagged"
}

Field notes:
- invoice_number: the broker invoice's OWN number as printed
- invoice_date: the broker invoice's OWN date as printed
- boe_number: the Bill of Entry number on the broker invoice — BOE and BE are the same document (Bill of Entry)
- boe_date: the Bill of Entry (BOE / BE) date as printed on the broker invoice
- hawb_number: the HAWB / air waybill number as printed on the broker invoice
- total_invoice_amount: the broker invoice's TOTAL amount (plain number, taxes included)
- pan: the pan number of the broker invoice as printed
Line items:
- description: the charge's full printed description
- hsn_sac: the row's SAC/HSN code as printed
- taxable: the row's taxable value (plain number)
- tax: the row's tax AMOUNT (plain number) — the money value only, never the rate/percentage (CGST/SGST components stay in this cell)
- total: the row's own TOTAL amount (taxes included)
the broker invoice's charge table (the rows of charges below the header); one line item = one printed charge row, in printed order. Copy the row's full description; the row's own TOTAL amount goes in 'total' (mandatory); taxable and tax as plain numbers from the row (split tax cells like CGST/SGST stay as printed). Do not include the table header, subtotal or total rows; do not merge or invent rows.
- If a field is not visible in the images, use value null, confidence 0, source null, source_region null — never fill from other documents or prior knowledge.
